question: What rewards may follow after receiving auspicious blessings?
premises: Auspicious blessings have been received after giving gifts.
Kingdom, wealth, fame, and sons are named as attainable outcomes.
Any other desired thing is also included among possible attainments.
inference: Receiving auspicious blessings can lead to obtaining these various desired rewards.
plain_english: One may obtain a kingdom, wealth, fame, sons, and any other desired thing.
